absolute_monitors_per_rail.supervisors: TWO LTC2914IGN-2#PBF per rail; one source window and one protected-output window, positive input mode
absolute_monitors_per_rail.fault_delay_condition: actual VH=VUOT-5mV orVL=VUOT+5mV; not a guarantee at infinitesimal overdrive or after amplifier overload

absolute_monitors_per_rail.after_bank_uv: LTC4261 UVL/UVH measure actual AGND-BANK_OUT. Missing/failed bank cannot admit pass RUN; independent deadline still expires.

independent_gate_clamps.primary_switching_test: RL200Ohm,VDD20V,IF5mA. Actual original Fig12.1 viewed: LED falling -> contact CLOSING is tON (max2ms at25C); LED rising -> contact OPENING is tOFF (max3ms at25C). Neither is a hot loaded-gate bound.
independent_gate_clamps.primary_leakage_rows: 10uA at60V/IF5mA,1uA at40V/IF2mA; neither is a full-temperature13V gate-node bound
independent_gate_clamps.led_drive: Two relay LEDs in SERIES per rail,383Ohm +/-3% feed from actualDIG5_FORCE.10k +/-3% shunt across the complete LED string prevents output leakage creating a half-enabled relay. SN74LVC1G06DBVR sinks the string only while release-permit HIGH; its input has47k defaultLOW.
independent_gate_clamps.release_logic: Both normally-closed clamps share one series LED string released byARM ANDAUX_VALID ANDGLOBAL_MASTER AND!FAULT. Linear pass stays OFF independently through translatedLTC4261ON untilSTART/PERMIT. This is NOT a single-fault-safe power-enable claim.

hardware_latches.supply: AUX; valid only after independentAUX_VALID. Every active clear/preset default is explicit.
hardware_latches.permit: CLK is direct physical START edge, NEVER START AND ARMED. D=ARMED AND SOURCE_GOOD AND !FAULT. Asynchronousclear=GLOBAL_VALID AND ARM AND !FAULT AND SOURCE_GOOD. START must satisfy actualAUP input transition/width/recovery requirements. Already-HIGH START cannot cause retry when SOURCE_GOOD/ARMED recovers.
hardware_latches.complete: CLK=PERMIT AND OUTPUT_GOOD (both transitions considered); D=1; CLR=PERMIT AND AUX_VALID. ItsQ remains latched during READY chatter; COMPLETE AND !OUTPUT_GOOD setsFAULT.
hardware_latches.fault: CLK is hardware FAULT_CONDITION = (ARM AND !SOURCE_GOOD) OR (ARM AND ENOUT AND !WDO) OR (COMPLETE AND !OUTPUT_GOOD). D=1 and PRE heldAUX; asynchronous clear onlywhileGLOBAL_VALIDLOW or explicitRESET withARMLOW. This replaces the discarded independentPRE/CLR assertion network, avoiding its structural forbidden-input overlap. Sensorpulse widths/clock recovery/logic hazards remain real AC qualification requirements; no infinitesimal-glitch capture claim.
hardware_latches.watchdog: TPS3431SDRBR per rail, EN=ARM, WDI=NOT_PERMIT, SET1=NOT_COMPLETE, CWD56nF/33nF. WaitENOUT/WDO then permitSTART. OnlyfirstPERMIT edge resets deadline. ARMLOW bothdisableswatchdog and immediatelyclearsPERMIT, so it cannot pause a liveRUN.
hardware_latches.global_hardoff: FAULT revokes pass isolatedON and bothNCgate-clampreleaseLEDs and retainedbankpermit. AUX_VALID andGLOBAL_MASTER are hard masks, not firmware promises.
